payload.claim: When a declared rename's new name was itself a test collected at base_sha independently of the pair (not just carried forward) and that name is also absent at head, the gate reports it twice: once as a `removed-test` failure (line 92) because it is a genuine pre-existing name that vanished, and again as `rename-not-collected` (line 96-104) because the declared pair's target never materialized. Both facts are true, so this is not a wrong computation, just a redundant pair of entries under two codes for the same `file` value in an edge case no test exercises.
